headline: India aims for 10% share in global 6G standards and patents
summary: Minister of State for Communications Dr. Chandra Sekhar Pemmasani announced India's goal to secure a 10% stake in global 6G patents and standards. Achieving these targets could significantly boost the domestic telecom manufacturing and software ecosystem.
